name: Hermes SSH Relay
tagline: Reach a Hermes agent over Tailscale SSH when no HTTP endpoint exists yet
description: Some Hermes setups live on a desktop with nothing exposed over HTTP, which normally leaves them unreachable from elsewhere. This one carries the conversation across a Tailscale SSH session instead, so the agent stays put and you still get to talk to it. A stopgap rather than a permanent design.
author: PixelRainbowNFT
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
